powershell_baseline.count_query:
FROM windows-apt-events-*
| WHERE event.provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" AND event.code == "1"
    AND TO_LOWER(process.name) IN ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
| STATS total_rows = COUNT(*)

historical_time_range.precision: nanoseconds; absent timestamps excluded only from min/max

powershell_refined.count_query:
FROM windows-apt-events-*
| WHERE event.provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" AND event.code == "1"
    AND TO_LOWER(process.name) IN ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
| EVAL command_lc = TO_LOWER(COALESCE(process.command_line, ""))
| EVAL retrieval = command_lc RLIKE ".*(invoke-webrequest|downloadstring|downloadfile|[^a-z0-9_]iwr[^a-z0-9_]).*",
    execution = command_lc RLIKE ".*(invoke-expression|[^a-z0-9_]iex[^a-z0-9_]|start-process).*",
    hidden = command_lc RLIKE ".*[ ]-(w|windowstyle)[ ]+hidden([ ].*)?",
    no_profile = command_lc RLIKE ".*[ ]-(nop|noprofile)([ ].*)?",
    inline_command = command_lc RLIKE ".*[ ]-(c|command)[ ]+.*"
| WHERE (retrieval AND execution) OR (hidden AND no_profile AND inline_command)
| STATS total_rows = COUNT(*)

historical_time_range.precision: nanoseconds; absent timestamps excluded only from min/max

service_config_baseline.count_query:
FROM windows-apt-events-*
| WHERE event.provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" AND event.code == "1"
    AND TO_LOWER(process.name) == "sc.exe"
    AND TO_LOWER(COALESCE(process.command_line, "")) LIKE "* config *"
    AND TO_LOWER(COALESCE(process.command_line, "")) LIKE "*binpath=*"
| STATS total_rows = COUNT(*)

historical_time_range.precision: nanoseconds; absent timestamps excluded only from min/max

| EVAL command_lc = TO_LOWER(COALESCE(process.command_line, ""))
| WHERE command_lc LIKE "* config *"
    AND command_lc RLIKE ".*binpath=.*(cmd[.]exe|powershell[.]exe|pwsh[.]exe).*"
| STATS total_rows = COUNT(*)

shell_refined.count_query:
FROM windows-apt-events-*
| WHERE event.provider == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" AND event.code == "1"
    AND TO_LOWER(process.name) == "cmd.exe"
| EVAL command_lc = TO_LOWER(COALESCE(process.command_line, ""))
| EVAL service_parent_interpreter = TO_LOWER(COALESCE(process.parent.name, "")) == "services.exe"
        AND command_lc RLIKE ".*(powershell[.]exe|pwsh[.]exe).*",
    service_control_interpreter = command_lc RLIKE ".*[ ]sc([.]exe)?[ ]+(create|config)[ ]+.*binpath=.*(cmd[.]exe|powershell[.]exe|pwsh[.]exe).*"
| WHERE service_parent_interpreter OR service_control_interpreter
| STATS total_rows = COUNT(*)

historical_time_range.precision: nanoseconds; absent timestamps excluded only from min/max

rules: Each individual metric counts distinct event.id within its named cohort.
Do not sum installation/create/config/registry observations into service or attack counts.
Correlation metric unit is an ordered pair or triple; recompute filtered tuples from all endpoints. Endpoint row counts and broad EQL 222 are not the complete denominator.
Snapshot metrics describe the full historical corpus. Do not imply that arbitrary dashboard filters recompute them; label fixed scope or implement verified tuple filtering.
Use exact event-ID sets or authoritative ES|QL for refined activity, not coarse KQL.
Derived ATT&CK IDs, rule names, correlation IDs and evidence categories are local analytic output, not fields installed in the source index.
Read service imagePath from _source or the verified artifact; never search disabled originals.
Display null user/process/correlation fields as unavailable; never fabricate severity, confidence or malicious/benign labels. Source strings must be escaped as inert text.
No malicious-versus-benign panel is supported; no network panel is needed for this scope.
Later implementation must compare every metric, historical range and evidence link with this contract before dashboard export; no dashboard is installed by this helper.
